scheme_name: India-Israel R&D Fund for Aerospace Innovation
eligibility: any organization registered in Israel can participate in the programme and benefit from R&I cooperation and European funding
benefits:
Access to Horizon Europe funding with a total programme budget of €95.5 billion (2021–2027)
Opportunity to participate in consortia with EU member states and associated countries
Access to funding across all major scientific and technological disciplines
Support for scientific excellence, global challenge addressing, and innovation
Access to European Innovation Council (EIC) Accelerator (grant up to €2.5M + equity up to €15M)
Access to European Research Council (ERC) grants
Access to Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA)
Reimbursement of expenses for Israeli companies submitting Horizon Europe proposals as part of a consortium (via Israel Innovation Authority)
Access to Technology Transfer Office (TTO) funding and business development opportunities under Horizon Europe
Access to European Innovation Council (EIC) Accelerator funding (up to €2.5M grant + €15M equity)
Access to European Research Council (ERC) grants (e.g., ERC Starting Grants)
Access to Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) fellowships
Access to European Innovation Council (EIC) Pathfinder and Transition funding
Access to Horizon Europe clusters: Health, Culture, Civil Security, Digital, Industry, Space, Climate, Food, etc.
Access to European Innovation Partnerships (EIPs) and European Innovation Council (EIC) Accelerator
Access to European Defence Fund (EDF) and Euratom research programmes (where applicable)
Access to European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT) Knowledge and Innovation Communities (KICs)
Access to European Innovation Council (EIC) Accelerator 'win-win' model: grant + equity investment
Access to mentoring and business development support via EIC Accelerator
Access to Technology Transfer Office (TTO) funding for international collaboration and market access
Access to Horizon Europe missions: Climate, Cancer, Oceans, Cities, Soil, Food
financial_support: Companies submitting proposals to Horizon Europe as part of a consortium can now benefit from financial support from the Israel Innovation Authority
application_process:
1. Identify relevant Horizon Europe calls via the ISERD website or EU Funding & Tenders Portal.
2. Use ISERD’s partner search tools (e.g., 'Horizon For All' portal) to find consortium partners from EU member states and associated countries.
3. Attend ISERD webinars and workshops (e.g., 'Sunday Morning with Horizon Europe', proposal writing workshops, partner search events) for guidance.
4. Develop proposal in accordance with the specific call’s guide for applicants.
5. Submit proposal via the EU Funding & Tenders Portal with Israeli entity as partner or coordinator.
6. For Israeli companies: apply to Israel Innovation Authority for reimbursement of proposal preparation expenses.
7. ISERD provides support in partner search, proposal writing, consortium building, and call information via webinars, workshops, and individual consultations.
